about: Answer key for sim/seed.json (T8). One case per planted mistake and decoy in docs/MASTER-PLAN.md §3, plus the demo-path purchase. T19 scores system decisions against it: a mistake is caught when the system's decision on refId is `expected` (or one of `alsoAccept`) and cites `rule`; it is missed otherwise. A decoy is a false alarm when the system fails `rule` on refId or holds/flags it for that rule. A hold for an unrelated reason (for example grant A's freeze) is not a false alarm. Any hold or flag on a record not listed here also counts as a false alarm.

assumptions.cardLimitRule: price <= cardLimit passes (exactly at the limit is allowed)
assumptions.last90DaysRule: materials and supplies (categories above) bought when the grant ends in 90 days or fewer fail; services, publication costs and payroll are not covered

expectedValues.hold: paused for the grant manager (a hold in the Inbox); for a grant event, the grant stays frozen and a flag is raised
expectedValues.block: refused outright, with the rule cited
expectedValues.reroute: charged to another grant with time and money left
expectedValues.exclude: left out of the payment request, with the reason
expectedValues.flag: an open flag on the grant (Funds window) and a hold for the grant manager
expectedValues.note: a note on the report, not a hold
expectedValues.pass: the rule passes; no hold or flag for it

cases.case: a grant active in one source and canceled in another
cases.rule: Any disagreement about status freezes spending and asks the grant manager
cases.check: open flag {kind: sources_disagree, grantId: R01GM061721}; a source_disagreement hold; grant stays frozen
cases.why: Today's RePORTER reading (sr-008) says active; USAspending (sr-009) and the cancellation list (sr-010) still say canceled.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.1 planted mistakes; MVP-REPORT test set: Grant Witness RePORTER/TAGGS mismatches

cases.rule: Frozen from a cancellation until a payment lands after it
cases.check: open flag {kind: spend_while_canceled, grantId: R01GM061721} naming rq-050 / o-050
cases.why: An $890 card charge (order o-050) hit R01GM061721 on 2026-03-18, eight days after it was canceled and with no payment since.

cases.case: a court order with no payment yet
cases.rule: A court order alone doesn't unfreeze; only a payment does
cases.check: grant R01GM061721 stays frozen; open flag {kind: court_order_no_payment, grantId: R01GM061721}
cases.why: The court restored the grant on 2026-04-20, but no payment has arrived since the 2026-03-10 cancellation.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.1 planted mistakes and §1 core behavior; pain point 02 (status reversed by courts)

cases.case: demo path: a purchase on a grant restored by court with no payment yet
cases.rule: Grant is active and not frozen
cases.check: rq-101 held (waiting_on_manager) with a purchase hold; bought automatically once a payment lands on R01GM061721
cases.why: The scientist pushes to buy gloves because the court restored the grant, but the money hasn't arrived.

cases.case: supplies bought in the last 90 days
cases.rule: Not in the grant's last 90 days
cases.check: rq-102 rerouted to R01GM061721 (it goes through once that grant unfreezes), or blocked; cites the last-90-days rule
cases.why: Lab supplies on R21AI182745, which ends 2026-08-31, 80 days after the request; R01GM061721 runs to 2027-07-31.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.2 planted mistakes; NSF OIG 22-1-010 (WVU, $17,335 disallowed) and OIG 19-1-011 (Delaware)

cases.check: rq-103 blocked; cites the category rule
cases.why: An espresso machine (general office) is not an allowable direct cost on a federal grant.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.2 planted mistakes; NSF OIG 17-1-002 (UC Davis)

cases.case: a shared cost charged 100% to one grant
cases.check: rq-104 not bought as-is: held for a split (or blocked); cites the shared-cost rule
cases.why: The confocal service contract serves both R01GM061721 and R21AI182745 (its purpose says so) but has no split.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.2 planted mistakes; NSF OIG capstone (shared-cost misallocation in 55% of audits)

cases.case: a buy over the card limit
cases.check: rq-105 waiting_on_manager with a purchase hold citing the card limit
cases.why: $6,850 is over the $5,000 card limit, so only the grant manager can approve it.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.2 planted mistakes and §2 hard limits

cases.case: a buy exactly at the limit
cases.check: card-limit verdict passes on rq-106; once R01GM061721 unfreezes it is bought with no hold
cases.why: $5,000 is exactly the limit, which is allowed. It waits only for grant A's freeze, not for the limit.

cases.check: shared-cost verdict passes on rq-107 (60% R01GM061721 / 40% R21AI182745); once R01GM061721 unfreezes it is bought with no hold
cases.why: Mass-spec hours split 6/4 between the two projects, matching its stated use. Core-facility services are not supplies, so the 90-day rule does not apply to B's share.

cases.case: an invoice for a canceled order
cases.rule: An invoice is payable only if its order is open
cases.check: inv-030 held with an invoice hold and a timeline: placed 2026-02-20, canceled 2026-03-02, invoice 2026-06-11
cases.why: BioReagents billed $2,400 for order o-030, which the lab canceled on 2026-03-02.

cases.case: an approval for a different amount
cases.rule: An invoice is payable only if its amount matches the approval
cases.check: inv-034 held with an invoice hold naming approval ap-034 ($5,800) vs invoice $6,200
cases.why: The grant manager approved the plate shaker at $5,800 (ap-034); the order and invoice are $6,200.

cases.case: an invoice matching an approved change to the order
cases.rule: An invoice is payable only if its amount matches the approval
cases.check: inv-036 matched (ready to pay); no hold
cases.why: Order o-036 changed from $1,150 to $1,290 with the grant manager's approval (ap-036); the invoice is $1,290.

cases.case: a held purchase that must be left out of the request
cases.rule: A request can't include held or frozen spending
cases.check: the May 2026 payment request for R21AI182745 (2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31) has rq-037 in `excluded`, not in includedRequestIds
cases.why: The broth order's invoice (inv-037) is on hold, waiting for the grant manager (h-004): billed $2,920 for a $1,460 order.

cases.case: a paper crediting the wrong grant
cases.rule: A listed paper must credit the grant whose report lists it
cases.check: p-10 held; proposes moving rq-035's $2,100 from R21AI182745 to R01GM061721 with 38 days left on the 90-day limit
cases.why: Listed in R21AI182745's report, but its acknowledgments credit R01GM061721; its publication fee was charged to R21AI182745.
cases.source: MASTER-PLAN §3.5 planted mistakes; §5 step 4; MVP-REPORT: WashU Single Audit 2023-001 (charge on the wrong grant, corrected late)

cases.case: a paper missing its PubMed Central ID
cases.rule: Every listed paper needs a PubMed Central ID (NIH public access policy)
cases.check: p-03 held (or flagged) for the missing PMCID
cases.why: The paper has no PMCID, which NIH requires for every paper in a progress report.

cases.case: a corrected paper listed without disclosure
cases.rule: Only a material correction holds the report
cases.check: p-04 held; asks to disclose the correction
cases.why: A material correction (Figure 3 rate constants, a revised conclusion) is on record but the report doesn't disclose it.

cases.rule: Only a material correction holds the report
cases.check: p-05 result is note (or ok), never held
cases.why: The only correction fixes one author's affiliation: too small to hold the report.

cases.case: a retracted paper cited in order to discuss the retraction
cases.rule: Only a material correction holds the report
cases.check: p-07 result is ok (or note), never held
cases.why: The retraction is on record and disclosed; the report lists the paper only to explain the retraction and the repeat experiments.
